_comment: Ticker -> offset applied to a market-data vendor's END-year fiscal label to match the company's OWN naming. -1 = company names the fiscal year by the year it BEGINS (4-5-4 retail calendar, e.g. DG calls the year ending ~Jan 2027 'fiscal 2026'). 0 (default, unlisted) = company uses the vendor end-year convention (e.g. NVDA, WMT, AAPL, UVV). The convention is per-company and must be verified against the issuer's 10-K before adding — do NOT infer it from the fiscal-year-end month. See tools/fiscal_calendar.py.
_validation: Checked against config/fiscal_year_end.json (235 priority tickers derived from Polygon). Of 33 non-December filers, only these four 4-5-4 retailers name by begin-year; the rest (incl. Jan-end NVDA/WMT/KBR/EXPO/CRAI and all Mar/Jun/Aug/Sep/Oct filers) use end-year naming and are intentionally left at offset 0. Expand only after per-company 10-K verification — even Feb-end retailers differ (ROST=begin, TJX=end).
